name: print-social-poster-portfolio-as-postage-stamps-on-black
title: Poster portfolio shown as perforated postage stamps on black with line self-portraits
whatItIs: A black board covered with posters framed as perforated postage stamps with denominations (₹5, 4) — Bollywood, music and type posters in red, yellow and teal — plus white line-drawn portraits of two designers.
whatItMeans: Collectible and personal; the stamp frame turns a body of work into a curated collection.
techniques: Frame each piece as a perforated stamp.
Sign the board with line-drawn self-portraits.

vocabulary.definition: The wavy punched edge of a stamp.
The printed value on a stamp.
